messages:
Sam: Heads up — ran into an ambiguity with the gateway matcher when a path contains a colon and when host captures are used. Example: `host: api:example.com` vs `path: /api/v1/:id` — parser treats `:` both as capture and as a host separator, so ambiguous.
Anya: oh dang, can you paste the concrete ruleset you hit?
Sam: sure:
```
- host: "*.example.com"
  path: "/api/v1/:resource/:id"
  service: "svc-api"
```
If someone sets `host: "api:example.com"` (rare) we currently accept colons in some legacy inputs which breaks capture detection.
Kevin: we should forbid colons in host patterns at validation and emit a specific lint error + console hint.
Sam: agreed. Also the precedence between host wildcards and service label routing is confusing. Current order in code is: exact host > host wildcard > path specificity > service weight. That was historical but feels non‑intuitive.
Anya: proposal: expose a small "explain match" API that returns match reason + matched tokens. Console can show a short trace: "Matched because host `api.example.com` exact, path capture id=123". That'd make debugging so much easier.
Sam: +1. This would also improve telemetry — we could correlate intended route vs actual matched route in dashboards.
Luis: edge-case: `/files/*` vs `/files/:id` — which wins? right now tie-breaker is alphabetical by route name which is terrible.
Kevin: suggest deterministic scoring: 1) number of static segments, 2) number of captures, 3) wildcard count (fewer better), 4) explicit route weight. That removes weird alphabetical tiebreaks.
Anya: also emit a `route.shadowing` metric when two routes score within the same bucket so we can alert on surprising overlaps. Console lint could show potential shadowing at save-time.
Sam: another nit: we need to support escaped regex captures like `:id([^/]+)` and render them human-friendly in the console (not raw regex). The explain API should return both the raw matcher and a humanized explanation.
Deploy-bot: deploy queued for matcher-syntax-fix branch — tests: 142 passed, 3 flaky.
Sam: ok let's spec the action items here: 1) disallow colons in host patterns (validation + migration docs) 2) implement deterministic scoring static>captures>wildcards>weight 3) add route-explain API + console hint/tooltip 4) emit shadowing telemetry + linter warning at route save 5) render humanized capture explanations for regex captures.
Anya: small UX ask: on hover show a compact "Why this route" with matched tokens and a link to full explain (and a link to the route diff in GH if applicable). :+1:
Kevin: i'll open a PR with the validation + metric emission (will include sample explain payload in the tests).
Luis: please add unit tests for overlaps like `/:a/*` vs `/:a/:b` and `/files/*` vs `/files/:id`. Also add an integration test that hits the console explain endpoint.
Sam: TY all — I'll file follow-ups and include a short snippet for the UI with suggested copy for the tooltip.
Anya: can we also add a small telemetry tag for "explain_requested" so we can see how often people rely on it vs using logs?
Sam: good idea. will add to spec.
Kevin: PR up later today. I'll ping here when ready.
Sam: sounds good. thanks everyone.
